summary: testArchivedChatsListAndRestorePreserveSelectionAndMetadata sets selectedSessionID via select() before calling openRightPane(.archivedChats), which only sets isRightPaneOpen/rightPaneMode (verified in AppModel.swift openRightPane/selectRightPaneMode has no selection-mutating code), then asserts selectedSessionID is unchanged -- a genuine, non-tautological rejection test that would fail if opening the pane cleared or reassigned the selection.
